# Cōntry

> Canonical URL: https://contry.app/

Cōntry is a browser-based country guessing game inspired by Wordle and Countryle.
Guess the hidden country using directional, categorical, and numeric clues.

## Key topics

- country guessing game
- wordle country guessing game
- countryle alternative
- geography puzzle game
- browser-based clue game

## Public pages

- https://contry.app/

## Product summary

Cōntry is an interactive geography guessing game where players try to identify a hidden country.
The game provides clue-based feedback through category matches, higher/lower numeric hints, and directional signals.

Arcade mode is local-first in the browser.
Ranked mode is backend-authoritative and requires authentication.
